decision.explanation: Saint Marcellus of Capua is primarily identified with 7 October in the General Roman Calendar, though some sources list 15 January; other saints named Marcellus (e.g., of Tangier or Pope Marcellus I) have different feast days (October 30 and January 16 respectively), which must be distinguished from the Capua saint.
